requirement_structuring.structuring_summary: Requirement is unambiguous and atomic. Structured as a single functional requirement preserving the original meaning.

source_fragments: The system shall inform the security service within 2 s after detecting damage.
structured_requirements.final_statement: The system shall inform the security service within 2 s after detecting damage.
structuring_notes: The requirement is treated as a functional action (inform) that must meet a specific performance criterion (2s). The condition is the detection of damage.
